A [[human]]<ref name="Encyclopedia Note" /> '''fleet technician''' served onboard the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Derriphan]]'' and under [[Captain]] [[Chesille Sabrond]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]]. The [[fleet technician]] was [[Death|killed]] when the [[Resistance]] destroyed the ''Derriphan''.<ref name="TROS-EE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The fleet technician first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="TROS" />
